source: KNBS Economic Survey (NTSA-reported road fatality data)
cacheNote: Bundled fallback used because SafeSteps has no live NTSA API connection configured. Replace this file (and set NTSA_CONFIG.enabled/endpoint in index.html) once an official NTSA data-sharing endpoint is available. Do not add hotspot-level data here unless it is confirmed against a named NTSA/county report.

national.note: Pedestrians were the single largest victim category; motorcyclists (boda boda riders and passengers) were the second-largest. Together, pedestrians, cyclists, and motorcyclists account for the large majority of road deaths in Kenya.

target.note: Consistent with Kenya's commitment to the UN Decade of Action for Road Safety.

trendNote: The 2025 pedestrian and motorcyclist totals are the published KNBS/NTSA figures. Earlier years and the cyclist/driver/passenger split are approximate magnitudes for trend context only — replace with exact NTSA annual-report figures when an official data-sharing endpoint is available.
